CHOCOCABIN WEBSITE PROTOTYPE

Extract the ZIP and open index.html in a modern browser.
For hosting, upload all files and the assets folder together. No build required.

Edit demo prices and product data in data.js.
Edit layout in index.html, styling in style.css, and interactions in app.js.

Prices are illustrative EUR demo prices. Tax, shipping and packaging are excluded.
Quotation generation is local: Print / Save as PDF and JSON download.
Email sending, SMS verification and order submission are not connected.
Product previews use supplied photos, not interactive 3D models.

SCROLL ANIMATION
89 optimized frames in assets/sequence. Scroll to scrub the product sequence.
Edit chapter text in index.html; edit sequence behavior in sequence.js.
Reduced-motion preferences show a static view.
